headline: Pharmacy Assistant

experience.title: Pharmacy Assistant
bullets: Fill about 200 prescriptions a day under the pharmacist's supervision.
Read prescriptions, check doses and generic names, and flag unclear ones to the pharmacist.
Receive deliveries, rotate stock by expiry date and run monthly counts.
Prepare senior citizen and PWD discount billing and daily sales reports.
Explain to customers how and when to take their medicines, as instructed by the pharmacist.

experience.title: Sales Clerk
bullets: Assisted customers with vitamins and over-the-counter products.
Restocked shelves and checked expiry dates.

summary: Pharmacy assistant with three years at a community drugstore in Pangasinan. I fill prescriptions under the pharmacist's supervision, read and check prescriptions, look after inventory, and help customers understand their medicines. I am accurate and customer-friendly.
skills: Pharmacy support and dispensing under supervision
